mostWorthwhile.text: Following the stones from wave abrasion to a sorted pebble shore made coastal erosion and sediment sorting concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the completed pebble shore was least useful: it had no available combinations, although that ruled out one possible route.

surprise.text: The sand needed wave-driven transport before it could accumulate in the sheltered bay; a beach is a moving sediment store rather than just a pile.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. My attempt to put sand directly in the bay was premature, but the feedback made the missing transport step clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the chapter linked practical combinations to useful explanations of abrasion, transport and deposition, while leaving room to discover the next step.
